repos.description: Supercharge your AI agents with data from the web and beyond. Building the library for superintelligence. 🔥
repos.summary_zh: Firecrawl 是一个专为 AI 设计的网页数据 API，可将任意网站转换为 LLM 可直接使用的结构化数据（如 Markdown、JSON、截图等），支持 JavaScript 渲染、动态内容抓取、批量处理和内容变更监控，显著提升 AI 应用的数据获取效率与准确性。
repos.summary_en: Firecrawl is a web data API designed for AI, converting any website into LLM-ready structured data (e.g., Markdown, JSON, screenshots). It supports JavaScript rendering, dynamic content extraction, batch processing, and change tracking, significantly enhancing data acquisition for AI applications.

repos.description: Open-source web crawler and scraper for LLMs and AI agents: any website into clean, LLM-ready Markdown. Run it yourself, or use Crawl4AI Cloud with one key.
repos.summary_zh: Crawl4AI 是一个开源的 LLM 友好型网络爬虫与抓取工具，专为将网页转换为干净、适合大语言模型（LLM）处理的 Markdown 格式而设计，广泛应用于 RAG、智能体和数据流水线场景。其核心亮点包括高吞吐量、可控性强、支持 Docker 部署，并具备崩溃恢复、预抓取加速等高级功能，拥有 5 万+ GitHub 星标社区。
repos.summary_en: Crawl4AI is an open-source, LLM-friendly web crawler and scraper that converts web pages into clean, LLM-ready Markdown for RAG, agents, and data pipelines. It features high throughput, Docker support, crash recovery, prefetch mode for 5-10x faster URL discovery, and is battle-tested by a 50k+ star community. Ideal for scalable, cost-effective web extraction.

repos.description: 小红书笔记 | 评论爬虫、抖音视频 | 评论爬虫、快手视频 | 评论爬虫、B 站视频 ｜ 评论爬虫、微博帖子 ｜ 评论爬虫、百度贴吧帖子 ｜ 百度贴吧评论回复爬虫  | 知乎问答文章｜评论爬虫
repos.summary_zh: MediaCrawler 是一个基于 Playwright 的多平台自媒体数据采集工具，支持小红书、抖音、B站等7大主流平台的公开内容抓取，具备关键词搜索、评论爬取、登录态缓存、IP代理池及词云图生成等功能，无需复杂逆向即可高效采集数据。
repos.summary_en: MediaCrawler is a powerful multi-platform media crawler built with Playwright, supporting data extraction from Xiaohongshu, Douyin, Bilibili, and 7+ platforms. It enables keyword search, comment scraping, login state caching, proxy pools, and comment word cloud generation without requiring complex reverse engineering.

repos.description: Scrapy, a fast high-level web crawling & scraping framework for Python.
repos.summary_zh: Scrapy 是一个高性能的 Python 网络爬虫框架，专为高效提取结构化数据而设计。支持跨平台运行，基于异步架构实现高并发抓取，提供灵活的中间件扩展机制，广泛用于数据采集、价格监控、内容聚合等场景。
repos.summary_en: Scrapy is a high-performance Python web crawling and scraping framework designed for extracting structured data from websites. Built on an asynchronous architecture, it enables high-concurrency data extraction with flexible middleware support, widely used in data collection, price monitoring, and content aggregation.

repos.description: ⭐AI-driven public opinion & trend monitor with multi-platform aggregation, RSS, and smart alerts.🎯 告别信息过载，你的 AI 舆情监控助手与热点筛选工具！聚合多平台热点 +  RSS 订阅，支持关键词精准筛选。AI 智能筛选新闻 + AI 翻译 +  AI 分析简报直推手机，也支持接入 MCP 架构，赋能 AI 自然语言对话分析、情感洞察与趋势预测等。支持 Docker ，数据本地/云端自持。集成微信/飞书/钉钉/Telegram/邮件/ntfy/bark/slack 等渠道智能推送。
repos.summary_zh: TrendRadar 是一款 AI 驱动的舆情监控工具，支持多平台热点聚合、RSS 订阅与智能关键词筛选，提供 AI 翻译与分析简报推送。集成微信/飞书/钉钉等 8+ 通知渠道，支持 Docker 部署与 MCP 架构，赋能 AI 对话分析、情感洞察与趋势预测，30 秒快速部署。
repos.summary_en: TrendRadar is an AI-powered public opinion and trend monitoring tool that aggregates multi-platform hot topics, RSS feeds, and offers smart keyword filtering. It delivers AI-translated analysis briefs via 8+ notification channels (WeChat, Feishu, DingTalk, etc.), supports Docker deployment and MCP architecture for AI-driven sentiment analysis and trend forecasting, with a 30-second setup.

repos.description: :arrow_double_down: Dumb downloader that scrapes the web
repos.summary_zh: You-Get 是一个轻量级命令行工具，用于从互联网下载视频、音频和图片内容，尤其适用于无官方下载渠道的网站。支持 YouTube、优酷等主流平台，具备流媒体播放、字幕下载及网页图片抓取功能，依赖 Python 和 FFmpeg，是开源的网页内容抓取工具。
repos.summary_en: You-Get is a lightweight command-line utility to download media (videos, audios, images) from the web when no official download option exists. It supports platforms like YouTube and Youku, enables streaming playback, subtitle extraction, and image scraping, and relies on Python and FFmpeg as core dependencies.

repos.description: A visual no-code/code-free web crawler/spider易采集：一个可视化浏览器自动化测试/数据采集/网页爬虫软件，可以无代码图形化的设计和执行爬虫任务。别名：ServiceWrapper面向Web应用的智能化服务封装系统。
repos.summary_zh: 易采集/EasySpider 是一款完全免费的视觉无代码浏览器自动化工具，支持图形化设计爬虫任务，无需编程即可实现网页数据采集与自动化测试。通过可视化操作选择网页元素，自动识别同类内容并批量采集，同时支持命令行模式嵌入其他系统，适用于电商、数据抓取等场景。
repos.summary_en: EasySpider is a completely free visual no-code web crawler and browser automation tool that enables users to design and execute data collection tasks through a graphical interface without programming. It automatically detects similar elements on web pages, supports batch data extraction, and can also run via command line for integration into other systems, ideal for e-commerce scraping and automation testing.

repos.description: Python ProxyPool for web spider
repos.summary_zh: ProxyPool 是一个 Python 实现的爬虫代理 IP 池，支持定时采集、验证和更新免费代理 IP，提供 RESTful API 接口。项目具备高可用代理源扩展能力，适用于网页爬虫、数据采集等场景，支持多版本 Python 环境及 Docker 部署，显著提升爬虫反爬绕过效率。
repos.summary_en: ProxyPool is a Python-based proxy IP pool for web scraping, featuring automated collection, validation, and management of free proxies. It offers a RESTful API for integration with crawlers, supports extensible proxy sources, and enables efficient anti-scraping bypass via rotating IPs. Compatible with Python 2.7–3.11 and deployable via Docker.

repos.description: Turn any website into a structured API. Extract, automate, search and monitor the web.
repos.summary_zh: Maxun 是一个开源无代码平台，专为实时网页抓取、爬取、搜索和 AI 数据提取设计，可将任意网站快速转换为结构化 API。支持录制操作、自然语言驱动提取、网页转 Markdown/HTML 及全站爬取，适用于构建自动化数据流水线，无需编程即可实现复杂的数据采集任务。
repos.summary_en: Maxun is an open-source no-code platform for real-time web scraping, crawling, search, and AI-powered data extraction. It transforms any website into a structured API in minutes, offering recorder mode, LLM-driven extraction, full-page scraping, and scalable crawling—ideal for building automated data pipelines without coding.

repos.description: 抖音 / TikTok 平台作品下载/数据采集工具
repos.summary_zh: DouK-Downloader 是一款基于 Python 和 HTTPX 的免费开源数据采集工具，支持批量下载抖音/TikTok 视频、图集、直播、合集及评论数据。具备 Web UI、API 接口、多线程下载、代理支持、增量采集、文件断点续传等功能，可部署至私有或公开服务器，适用于内容创作者、数据分析师等场景。
repos.summary_en: DouK-Downloader is a free open-source data collection tool built with Python and HTTPX, enabling batch downloads of videos, albums, live streams, collections, and comments from Douyin/TikTok. It features Web UI, API interface, multi-threaded downloads, proxy support, incremental scraping, and resume capability, deployable on private or public servers for content creators and data analysts.

repos.description: MCP for xiaohongshu.com
repos.summary_zh: 小红书 MCP 是一个专为 xiaohongshu.com 设计的自动化工具，支持登录验证、图文/视频内容发布、内容搜索、推荐列表获取、帖子详情抓取、评论互动及用户主页信息提取。采用本地路径优先的图片处理机制，确保上传稳定性，并提供完整的 HTTP API 与 MCP 工具调用支持，适用于内容运营与数据采集场景。
repos.summary_en: Xiaohongshu MCP is an automation tool designed for xiaohongshu.com, supporting login verification, publishing text/image and video content, searching posts, fetching recommended feeds, retrieving post details with interactions, commenting, and user profile data extraction. It prioritizes local file paths for media uploads to ensure stability, and offers full HTTP API and MCP tool integration for content operations and data collection.

repos.description: Make Any Website & Tool Your CLI. A universal CLI Hub and AI-native runtime. Transform any website, Electron app, or local binary into a standardized command-line interface. Built for AI Agents to discover, learn, and execute tools seamlessly via a unified AGENT.md integration.
repos.summary_zh: OpenCLI 是一个强大的 AI 原生浏览器自动化工具，可将任意网站或 Electron 应用转换为命令行接口。它支持会话复用、AI 驱动的发现与合成，提供零风险的数据提取和跨平台自动化能力，适用于 Bilibili、知乎、小红书等主流平台。
repos.summary_en: OpenCLI is a powerful, AI-native browser automation tool that turns any website or Electron app into a CLI. It enables seamless web data extraction and automation with session reuse, AI-powered discovery, and dynamic adapter loading, supporting platforms like Bilibili, Zhihu, and Xiaohongshu.

repos.description: A faster, simpler way to drive browsers supporting the Chrome DevTools Protocol.
repos.summary_zh: chromedp 是一个高效的 Go 语言库，用于通过 Chrome DevTools 协议驱动浏览器，无需外部依赖。它支持无头模式运行、页面截图、自动化操作等场景，适用于网页爬虫、自动化测试和数据采集。核心优势包括高性能、简洁 API 和跨平台兼容性。
repos.summary_en: chromedp is a high-performance Go library for driving browsers via the Chrome DevTools Protocol without external dependencies. It supports headless browsing, page screenshots, and automation tasks like web scraping and testing. Key features include fast execution, simple API, and cross-platform compatibility.

repos.description: 小红书（XiaoHongShu、RedNote）链接提取/作品采集工具
repos.summary_zh: XHS-Downloader 是一款功能强大的小红书（XiaoHongShu/RedNote）作品采集与下载工具，支持提取账号作品、收藏、点赞链接，采集作品信息及下载地址，批量下载图文、视频、LivePhoto 文件，具备断点续传、文件完整性校验、自定义命名格式、剪贴板监听、MCP 调用等高级功能，适用于内容创作者与数据收集场景。
repos.summary_en: XHS-Downloader is a powerful tool for extracting and downloading content from Xiaohongshu (XHS/RedNote). It supports fetching posts, likes, collections, and albums, downloading media files (images, videos, LivePhotos), with features like resume downloads, file integrity checks, custom naming, clipboard monitoring, and MCP integration, ideal for content creators and data collectors.

repos.description: GEO-first SEO skill for Claude Code. Comprehensive AI search optimization for any website — citability scoring, AI crawler analysis, brand authority, schema markup, platform-specific optimization, and PDF reports.  If you want learn how to sell this to real businesses, check out the skool community
repos.summary_zh: 专为 Claude Code 设计的 GEO-first SEO 技能，提供全面的 AI 搜索引擎优化服务，包括内容可引用性评分、AI 爬虫分析、品牌权威性评估、结构化数据生成及跨平台优化，支持 PDF 报告输出，助力企业抢占 AI 流量入口。
repos.summary_en: A GEO-first SEO skill for Claude Code that delivers comprehensive AI search optimization, including citability scoring, AI crawler analysis, brand authority assessment, schema markup generation, and platform-specific tuning, with professional PDF reporting capabilities to capture high-converting AI-driven traffic.

repos.description: UAParser.js: The Essential Web Development Tool for User-Agent Detection. Detect Browsers, OS, Devices, Bots, Apps, AI Crawlers, and more. Run in Browser or Node
repos.summary_zh: UAParser.js 是一款轻量级、高性能的 JavaScript 库，支持在浏览器和 Node.js 环境中解析 User-Agent 字符串，精准识别浏览器、操作系统、设备类型、CPU 架构、机器人及 AI 爬虫等信息，适用于前端分析、服务端日志处理和跨平台兼容性检测。
repos.summary_en: UAParser.js is a lightweight, high-performance JavaScript library that parses User-Agent strings in both browser (client-side) and Node.js (server-side) environments. It accurately detects browsers, operating systems, devices, CPU architectures, bots, AI crawlers, and more, making it ideal for analytics, compatibility checks, and intelligent routing.

repos.description: SEX IS ZERO (0), so, who wanna be the ONE (1), aha?
repos.summary_zh: hardseed 是一个从草榴和愛城论坛批量下载种子与图片的自动化工具，支持代理配置、文件名安全处理及智能重试机制，适用于资源抓取与离线保存，操作简单且适配多平台。
repos.summary_en: hardseed is a batch download utility for seeds and pictures from CaoLiu and AiCheng forums, featuring proxy support, safe filename handling, and intelligent retry logic, designed for efficient resource scraping and offline archiving with cross-platform compatibility.

repos.description: https://getsurfboard.com
repos.summary_zh: Surfboard 是一个专为 AI 智能体设计的自动化工具平台，支持网页爬虫、数据抓取与任务自动化。它提供直观的界面和强大的调度能力，帮助用户快速构建和部署 AI 驱动的自动化工作流，适用于内容聚合、数据收集等场景。
repos.summary_en: Surfboard is an automation platform designed for AI agents, enabling web scraping, data extraction, and task automation. It offers an intuitive interface and robust scheduling to help users build and deploy AI-driven workflows efficiently, ideal for content aggregation and data collection.

repos.description: Tabula is a tool for liberating data tables trapped inside PDF files
repos.summary_zh: Tabula 是一款开源工具，专用于从 PDF 文件中提取结构化表格数据，支持 CSV 格式输出。其核心优势在于本地化处理，确保数据安全，仅适用于文本型 PDF（非扫描件）。项目虽非活跃维护，但底层 Java 库 tabula-java 持续更新，适合数据分析师、记者等处理 PDF 表格的场景。
repos.summary_en: Tabula is an open-source tool designed to extract structured table data from PDF files into CSV format. It emphasizes local processing for data security and works only with text-based PDFs (not scanned documents). While the main app is no longer actively maintained, the underlying tabula-java library continues to receive updates, making it suitable for data analysts and journalists handling PDF tables.

repos.description: 🚀 Free HTTP, SOCKS4, & SOCKS5 proxy list * Updated every 5 minutes * and rotating proxy API (100+ countries)
repos.summary_zh: Proxifly 是一个高性能的免费代理 IP 池，每 5 分钟自动抓取并验证全球 HTTP、HTTPS、SOCKS4 和 SOCKS5 代理。提供 JSON、TXT、CSV 多格式下载及 NPM 模块，支持按国家与协议筛选，适用于网页爬虫、数据抓取与隐私保护等场景。
repos.summary_en: Proxifly is a high-performance free proxy pool that automatically scrapes and validates global HTTP, HTTPS, SOCKS4, and SOCKS5 proxies every 5 minutes. It offers multi-format downloads (JSON, TXT, CSV), an NPM module, and filtering by country/protocol, ideal for web scraping, data extraction, and privacy protection.

repos.description: One-stop Proxies Crawling and Aggregation Platform
repos.summary_zh: Aggregator 是一个高效免费的代理池构建工具，支持从 Telegram、GitHub 等多平台爬取代理资源，自动验证质量并转换为 Clash、V2Ray 等格式，提供 GitHub Gist 等灵活存储后端，适用于个人及企业级代理订阅管理。
repos.summary_en: Aggregator is a powerful free proxy pool builder that crawls proxy resources from multiple platforms like Telegram and GitHub, automatically validates quality, and converts them into formats such as Clash and V2Ray. It supports flexible storage backends like GitHub Gist and is ideal for personal and enterprise proxy subscription management.

repos.description: 一个自己找热点、自己写日报的网站框架。把信源和精选标准换成你的，它就是你的行业热点站。
repos.summary_zh: AIHOT 是一个开源的行业热点监测框架，自动从多源采集资讯，经大模型预筛、双评分与去重聚簇，生成中文标题、摘要与日报/周报/月报，支持 RSS、X、微信公众号等信源，可快速部署为法律、金融、HR 等垂直领域的智能热点站。
repos.summary_en: AIHOT is an open-source framework for industry-specific news aggregation. It auto-collects from RSS, web, X and WeChat, applies AI pre-filtering, dual scoring and event clustering, then generates Chinese headlines, summaries and daily/weekly/monthly reports. Deployable as a vertical hotspot dashboard for legal, financial, HR domains.

repos.description: Redis-based components for Scrapy.
repos.summary_zh: Scrapy-Redis 是基于 Redis 的分布式爬虫组件，支持多实例共享任务队列与去重，实现高效分布式网页抓取与后处理。提供 Scrapy 即插即用调度器、去重过滤器、Item Pipeline 及基础 Spider，增强爬虫扩展性与并发能力。
repos.summary_en: Scrapy-Redis provides Redis-based distributed components for Scrapy, enabling shared task queues and deduplication across multiple spider instances. It supports distributed crawling, post-processing, and plug-and-play architecture with scheduler, filter, and pipeline components for scalable web scraping.

repos.description: The go-to web for your AI coding agent — local-first search, fetch, crawl & research over MCP. No API keys, no cloud, $0/query. Public beta.
repos.summary_zh: wigolo 是一款本地优先的 AI 智能体网页情报 MCP 服务器，为 AI 编程助手提供搜索、抓取、爬取及自主研究能力。它完全运行于本地（~/.wigolo/），无需 API 密钥或云服务，实现零成本查询，支持 Claude Code、Cursor 等主流工具，是 AI 时代替代传统付费搜索 API 的隐私保护方案。
repos.summary_en: wigolo is a local-first MCP server delivering web intelligence for AI coding agents. It provides search, fetch, crawl, and autonomous research capabilities entirely on-device without API keys or cloud services. Supporting Claude Code, Cursor, and other major tools, it offers a privacy-focused, zero-cost alternative to metered search APIs.

repos.description: Self-hosted webscraper.
repos.summary_zh: Scraperr 是一款强大的自托管网页爬虫解决方案，支持无代码配置、XPath精准提取、多任务队列管理、媒体下载及结果可视化导出，适用于数据采集与自动化分析场景。
repos.summary_en: Scraperr is a powerful self-hosted web scraping tool enabling code-free configuration, XPath-based extraction, queue management, media downloads, and structured data export, ideal for automated data collection and analysis.

repos.description: Collection of China illegal cases about web crawler 本项目用来整理所有中国大陆爬虫开发者涉诉与违规相关的新闻、资料与法律法规。致力于帮助在中国大陆工作的爬虫行业从业者了解我国相关法律，避免触碰数据合规红线。
repos.summary_zh: 本项目系统整理中国大陆爬虫开发者违法违规案例，涵盖隐私数据抓取、商业数据侵权、验证码破解服务等场景，并解析《刑法》《网络安全法》等法律条文，为从业者提供合规指引，避免触碰数据安全与个人信息保护的法律红线。
repos.summary_en: This project compiles Chinese web crawler violation cases involving illegal data collection, commercial infringement, and unauthorized access. It analyzes relevant laws including the Criminal Law and Cybersecurity Law to guide practitioners in avoiding legal risks related to data compliance and personal information protection.

repos.description: Collection of China illegal cases about web crawler 本项目用来整理所有中国大陆爬虫开发者涉诉与违规相关的新闻、资料与法律法规。致力于帮助在中国大陆工作的爬虫行业从业者了解我国相关法律，避免触碰数据合规红线。 [AD]企业租显卡算力部署AI请选Novagrid
repos.summary_zh: 本项目系统整理中国大陆爬虫开发者违法违规案例，涵盖隐私数据抓取、商业数据侵权、验证码破解服务等五大禁区，并附相关法律法规解读与律师观点，旨在警示从业者遵守数据合规要求，规避法律风险。
repos.summary_en: This project compiles illegal cases involving Chinese web crawler developers, covering five major violation zones such as privacy data scraping and commercial data infringement. It includes legal regulations and expert opinions to help practitioners comply with data compliance and avoid legal risks.

repos.description: IPProxyPool代理池项目，提供代理ip
repos.summary_zh: IPProxyPool是一个开源代理IP池项目，支持Python 2/3，提供高匿、匿名和透明代理IP抓取与验证服务。通过多线程爬虫自动采集代理源，结合评分机制筛选可用IP，支持HTTP/HTTPS协议及国内外地域过滤。项目采用SQLite默认数据库，可扩展至MySQL、MongoDB等，并提供RESTful API供外部调用，适用于爬虫、数据采集等场景。
repos.summary_en: IPProxyPool is an open-source proxy IP pool project supporting Python 2/3, offering automated collection and validation of anonymous, high-anonymity, and transparent proxy IPs. It uses multi-threaded crawlers to gather proxies from multiple sources, filters them via a scoring system, and supports HTTP/HTTPS protocols with geographic filtering. Built on SQLAlchemy ORM, it defaults to SQLite but can be extended to MySQL or MongoDB. A RESTful API enables external access for use in web scraping and data collection applications.

repos.description: ShadowsocksR update rss, SSR organization https://github.com/shadowsocksr
repos.summary_zh: ShadowsocksR C# 版本4.8.0 是一个全能代理工具，支持Socks4/4a/5、HTTP协议，具备节点统计、连接管理、UDP-over-TCP、多重代理及自定义协议插件功能。支持服务器订阅与自动更新，提供GPG签名校验确保安全性，适用于绕过网络限制与隐私保护。
repos.summary_en: ShadowsocksR C# v4.8.0 is a comprehensive proxy tool supporting Socks4/4a/5, HTTP, with features like node statistics, connection management, UDP-over-TCP, multi-hop proxying, and custom protocol plugins. It supports server subscription with GPG signature verification for security, ideal for bypassing censorship and enhancing privacy.

repos.description: 一个基于✨HOOK机制的微信机器人，支持🌱安全新闻定时推送【FreeBuf，先知，安全客，奇安信攻防社区】，👯Kfc文案，⚡漏洞查询，⚡手机号归属地查询，⚡知识库查询，🎉星座查询，⚡天气查询，🌱摸鱼日历，⚡微步威胁情报查询， 🐛视频，⚡图片，👯帮助菜单。📫 支持积分功能，⚡支持自动拉人，，🌱自动群发，👯Ai回复（国内主流AI模型，扣子，FastGpt，Dify全面支持！），⚡视频号解析，😄自定义程度丰富，小白也可轻松上手！
repos.summary_zh: NGCBot 是一款基于 HOOK 机制的微信机器人，集成安全资讯推送、AI 智能回复、漏洞查询、天气日历等丰富功能，支持主流 AI 平台，具备自动拉群、群发、视频解析等自动化能力，自定义程度高，适合安全从业者与社群运营。
repos.summary_en: NGCBot is a HOOK-based WeChat robot supporting security news push, AI replies, vulnerability queries, weather, calendar, and more. It integrates with major AI platforms, offers automation features like auto-invite and group messaging, and is highly customizable for non-technical users.

repos.description: 🚀 A statistical analysis tool for performance testing
repos.summary_zh: Hiper 是一款专为性能测试设计的统计分析工具，支持通过 Chrome 浏览器自动化采集页面加载时间、DNS 查询、TCP 连接等关键性能指标，提供详细的统计报告与可视化分析，适用于 Web 性能监控与优化。
repos.summary_en: Hiper is a statistical analysis tool for performance testing that automates Chrome browser interactions to collect key metrics like DNS lookup, TCP connection, and page load times, delivering detailed reports and visualizations for web performance monitoring and optimization.

repos.description: 一个基于 AI 的 Hacker News 中文播客项目，每天自动抓取 Hacker News 热门文章，通过 AI 生成中文总结并转换为播客内容。
repos.summary_zh: Agili 的 Hacker Podcast 是一个基于 AI 的 Hacker News 中文播客项目，每日自动抓取热门文章，利用 AI 生成中文摘要并转换为语音播客。项目采用 Cloudflare Workers 部署，结合 OpenAI API 与 TTS 技术，支持多平台订阅，实现技术资讯的自动化聚合与分发。
repos.summary_en: Agili's Hacker Podcast is an AI-powered Chinese podcast project that automatically fetches daily top articles from Hacker News, generates Chinese summaries via AI, and converts them into audio content. Built with Cloudflare Workers, OpenAI API, and TTS, it supports multi-platform RSS and web access for automated tech news aggregation.

repos.description: python ip proxy tool  scrapy crawl. 抓取大量免费代理 ip，提取有效 ip 使用
repos.summary_zh: 基于 Scrapy 的 Python 代理 IP 抓取与验证工具，支持多源采集、异步验证、MySQL 存储及 RESTful 数据接口，提供高匿/匿名/透明代理筛选与 HTTPS 支持检测，适用于爬虫反爬、数据采集等场景。
repos.summary_en: A Python-based proxy IP crawler and validator using Scrapy, featuring multi-source scraping, asynchronous validation, MySQL storage, and RESTful API for filtering proxies by anonymity and HTTPS support, ideal for web scraping and anti-bot bypass.

repos.description: A powerful no-code automation tool. Build workflows via drag-and-drop modules for web scraping, form filling and automated testing. | 一款功能强大的自动化工具，通过拖拽模块的方式快速构建自动化工作流，无需编写任何代码即可实现网页数据采集、表单填写、自动化测试等任务。【QQ交流群：115069513】
repos.summary_zh: Web RPA 是一款强大的可视化网页自动化工具，支持零代码拖拽构建自动化工作流，涵盖网页数据采集、表单填写、自动化测试等场景。基于 FastAPI + React 架构，集成 273 个功能模块，涵盖浏览器自动化、数据处理、数据库操作、媒体处理、PDF 转换、文档转换等全栈能力，提供智能搜索、Mermaid 流程图、变量自动补全等高效开发特性，支持非商业免费使用。
repos.summary_en: Web RPA is a powerful visual automation tool enabling zero-code workflow creation via drag-and-drop. It supports web scraping, form filling, and testing with 273 built-in modules across browser automation, data processing, database operations, media handling, PDF conversion, and document transformation. Built on FastAPI + React, it offers smart search, Mermaid flowcharts, variable autocompletion, and full non-commercial free usage.

repos.description: Flexible Node.js crawler library
repos.summary_zh: x-crawl 是一个灵活的 Node.js AI 辅助爬虫库，集成 Ollama 和 OpenAI，支持动态/静态页面、接口及文件数据抓取，具备设备指纹伪装、代理轮换、失败重试、优先级队列等功能，通过 AI 智能解析应对网页结构变更，提升爬虫效率与智能化水平。
repos.summary_en: x-crawl is a flexible Node.js AI-assisted crawler library integrating Ollama and OpenAI. It supports dynamic/static pages, API, and file data crawling with features like device fingerprinting, proxy rotation, retry mechanisms, and priority queues. AI-powered semantic parsing helps adapt to website structural changes, enhancing efficiency and intelligence.

repos.description: Boss直聘爬虫 / BOSS直聘职位数据抓取工具，基于 Chrome CDP 协议复用真实登录态，绕过字体反爬，输出明文薪资 JSON/CSV + 薪资技能分析。A Chrome-CDP-based BOSS Zhipin job scraper/crawler.
repos.summary_zh: 基于 Chrome CDP 协议的 BOSS直聘职位抓取工具，通过复用本地真实登录态调用官方搜索 API，有效绕过前端字体反爬机制，直接获取明文薪资数据。支持 JSON/CSV 双格式输出，并提供薪资分布、技能词频分析及求职材料优化提示词生成，可作为 CLI 工具或 Hermes Agent Skill 使用。
repos.summary_en: A Chrome CDP-based BOSS Zhipin job scraper that leverages local authenticated sessions to invoke official search APIs, effectively bypassing font anti-scraping to extract plain-text salary data. It supports JSON/CSV output and provides salary distribution analysis, skill frequency statistics, and job application prompt generation, usable as both a CLI tool and a Hermes Agent Skill.

repos.description: MemFree - Hybrid AI Search Engine & AI Page Generator
repos.summary_zh: MemFree 是一款混合 AI 搜索引擎与 AI 页面生成器，支持多模态输入（文本/图片/文件）、多 AI 模型（Claude/GPT/Gemini）及多搜索引擎，可快速检索知识库与全网信息并生成生产级 UI 页面，显著提升效率并降低成本。
repos.summary_en: MemFree is a Hybrid AI Search Engine & AI Page Generator that supports multimodal inputs (text/images/files), integrates multiple AI models (Claude/GPT/Gemini) and search engines, enabling fast retrieval from knowledge bases and the web, plus instant generation of production-ready UI pages to boost efficiency and reduce costs.

repos.description: 一款完全开源的微信公众号文章获取、RSS 订阅 API 服务，支持整号文章一键导出 7 种格式（Markdown/HTML/Word/PDF/EPUB/Excel/JSON）、IP 代理池反风控、MCP 接入各种 AI Agent 工具。
repos.summary_zh: 完全开源的微信公众号文章获取与RSS订阅API服务，支持Chrome TLS指纹模拟、SOCKS5代理池反风控，提供公众号搜索、文章抓取、图片代理及Webhook通知功能。基于FastAPI构建，支持Docker一键部署和多架构兼容，本地扫码登录即可使用。
repos.summary_en: Fully open-source WeChat public account article fetching and RSS subscription API service with Chrome TLS fingerprint simulation, SOCKS5 proxy pool anti-detection, supporting account search, article scraping, image proxy, and webhook notifications. Built on FastAPI, Docker-deployable across multiple architectures, accessible via local QR login.

repos.description: 微信公众号文章抓取 & Markdown 转换工具
repos.summary_zh: 该工具利用 Camoufox 实现反检测抓取，自动提取微信公众号文章的标题、账号、发布时间及原文链接，并将 HTML 内容转换为结构清晰的 Markdown 格式，同时下载图片至本地并重写链接，支持代码块语法高亮，适用于内容归档与知识管理。
repos.summary_en: This tool uses Camoufox for anti-detection fetching to extract WeChat Official Account articles, converting HTML content into clean Markdown with metadata (title, account, publish time, URL), downloading images locally, and preserving code blocks with language syntax. Ideal for content archiving and knowledge management.

repos.description: 爬取微信公众号文章
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库通过搜狗微信接口爬取微信公众号文章，支持获取账号信息、文章列表及全文内容，集成反爬虫机制与动态渲染技术，适用于内容聚合与数据分析场景。
repos.summary_en: This repository scrapes WeChat Official Account articles via Sogou's WeChat search platform, supporting account info retrieval, article list parsing, and full content extraction. It includes anti-scraping measures and dynamic rendering support for content aggregation and data analysis.

repos.description: AigoTools can help users quickly create and manage website directory, with built-in site auto-crawling features, and also provides internationalization, SEO, image storage, and other functions. It allows users to quickly deploy their own directory site online.
repos.summary_zh: AigoTools 是一款开源的网站目录导航系统，支持一键部署个人导航站点。内置基于 Playwright/Jina/OpenAI 的自动网站收录功能，集成 SEO 优化、多语言国际化、暗黑/亮色主题切换，并提供 MinIO/AWS S3/腾讯云 COS 多种图片存储方案，适合快速搭建个性化网站导航平台。
repos.summary_en: AigoTools is an open-source website directory/navigation system enabling one-click deployment of personal navigation sites. It features automatic site crawling via Playwright/Jina/OpenAI, integrated SEO optimization, multilingual i18n, dark/light theme toggle, and multiple image storage options including MinIO, AWS S3, and Tencent Cloud COS — ideal for quickly building personalized navigation platforms.

repos.description: AigoTools can help users quickly create and manage website directory, with built-in site auto-crawling features, and also provides internationalization, SEO, image storage, and other functions. It allows users to quickly deploy their own directory site online.
repos.summary_zh: AigoTools 是一款导航站建站工具，支持快速创建和管理网站目录，内置自动爬虫抓取站点信息（基于 Playwright、Jina、OpenAI），提供用户管理、国际化、SEO 优化及多平台图片存储（MinIO、AWS S3、腾讯云 COS）。用户可一键部署个性化导航网站，适合内容聚合与分类管理场景。
repos.summary_en: AigoTools is a navigation site builder that enables rapid creation and management of website directories with built-in auto-crawling (using Playwright, Jina, OpenAI), user management (Clerk), internationalization, SEO, and multi-cloud image storage (MinIO, AWS S3, Tencent COS). It allows instant deployment of customizable navigation sites for content aggregation and categorization.

repos.description: Python爬虫，返回一定格式的信息，下载，使用flask提供简易api。抖音无水印、皮皮虾、快手、网易云音乐、qq音乐、咪咕音乐、荔枝FM音频、知乎视频、最右语音、视频、微博......
repos.summary_zh: 该项目是一个基于 Python 的网页爬虫集合，支持抖音、快手、网易云音乐、知乎等平台的无水印视频、音频及内容下载，通过 Flask 提供简易 API 接口。代码风格较旧但功能实用，现计划迁移至 FastAPI 框架重构，适合学习或日常使用。
repos.summary_en: This project is a collection of Python web crawlers for downloading unwatermarked videos, audio, and content from platforms like Douyin, Kuaishou, NetEase Music, and Zhihu. It provides a simple API via Flask. The codebase is outdated but functional, with plans to migrate to FastAPI for better structure and usability.

repos.description: A fast, native RSS reader — plus an agent-facing CLI so your AI agent can read, search and triage your feeds from the shell.
repos.summary_zh: Papr 是一款专为桌面端设计的快速原生 RSS 阅读器，支持订阅管理、智能分类、全文抓取、AI 摘要与问答、音频播放及 FreshRSS 同步，数据本地存储于 SQLite，无云端依赖，提供多语言界面。
repos.summary_en: Papr is a fast, native desktop RSS reader featuring feed organization, smart views, full-text fetching, AI-powered summaries and Q&A, audio playback, FreshRSS sync, and local-first data storage via SQLite—no cloud or account required.

repos.description: Scrapy extension to write scraped items using Django models
repos.summary_zh: scrapy-djangoitem 是一个 Scrapy 扩展，允许使用 Django 模型定义 Scrapy 项目中的 Item。它提供 DjangoItem 类，将 Django 模型字段自动映射为 Scrapy Item 字段，并支持通过 save() 方法将抓取数据直接保存为 Django 模型实例，简化了爬虫与 Django 应用的数据集成。
repos.summary_en: scrapy-djangoitem is a Scrapy extension that enables defining Scrapy items using existing Django models. It provides the DjangoItem class, which automatically maps Django model fields to Scrapy item fields and supports saving scraped data directly into Django model instances via the save() method, streamlining integration between Scrapy crawlers and Django applications.

repos.description: WeSpy 是一个用于获取wx公众号文章并转换为 Markdown 格式的 Python 工具
repos.summary_zh: WeSpy 是一个专为微信公众号设计的 Python 工具，可抓取文章并转换为 Markdown 格式，支持防盗链处理、专辑批量下载及多格式输出（Markdown/HTML/JSON），提供命令行和 Python API 两种使用方式。
repos.summary_en: WeSpy is a Python tool designed for scraping WeChat Official Account articles and converting them to Markdown format. It supports anti-hotlinking image handling, batch album downloads, and multi-format output (Markdown/HTML/JSON), with both CLI and Python API interfaces.
